measurement_scope: Receiver userspace first video RTP packet to decoder buffer delivery, GL draw submission and Qt frameSwapped notification. No camera clock, physical GPU completion or monitor scanout measurement.
revision_scope: The final contract and telemetry-on/off runs include generic buffer-list support, pause/generation gap closure and background header-prepend trace retention. Earlier hardware RTP, renderer, SDK/headless and 90-second regression runs exercise the same timing paths before those targeted refinements; the frozen hour run has the additional differences listed below.
classification: Correctness tests and existing recording/resource guards have assertions. Latency and FPS are observations without operational pass/fail thresholds.

rtp_b_frames.fixtures: 640x360 BT.709 limited 8-bit, 30 FPS, keyint=30, bframes=3; RTP timestamp/sequence offsets force wrap. Matroska retains original reorder timestamps.

statistics.notes: Window P99 summaries are not whole-run percentiles. CPU percent is relative to one logical core. No latency or FPS pass/fail classification.

hour_soak.runtime_scope: Background input/decode correspondence was unavailable in this intermediate runtime; the final on/off run verifies its repair. Concurrent regression tests ran during part of this soak; final on/off runs are isolated. Frozen intermediate runtime: before final B-frame identity preservation, partial-input/audio filtering, hide/repaint and canonical timestamp refinements, generic buffer-list support, final-gap retirement accounting and background header-prepend trace retention. Hour fixtures contain no B frames/audio/hide operations. Final runtime is covered separately by correctness, real B-frame/RTP, renderer, SDK/headless and on/off runs.

telemetry_overhead.note: Sequential isolated 90-second runs on identical 20-input/16-selected fixtures, statistics after 60 seconds, including validator snapshots/JSON serialization. A single pair is an observation, not a performance guarantee or acceptance decision.
